title: The 7-day anti-rug dry-run floor measures calendar time since the first listener start: time with the bot off counts, no observed pool event is required, and the stamp never resets

evidence.note: the stamp is written on every startChainAntiRugListener call, with or without positions and before any event
INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... COALESCE keeps the first stamp forever
the gate is only now minus stamp >= SEVEN_DAYS_SEC (:127)
preflight runs at boot and is fatal on failure, so the gate is checked only at boot
in dry-run the breaker is never reached, so the dry run does not exercise it
documented rule: flip to true ONLY after a 7-day dry run with 0 confirmed false positives; the false-positive review is not in code

sibling_sites_checked: Every reader and writer of antirug_dry_run_started (db.ts:186-188 column, :702-709 statements; detector.ts:585; preflight.ts:640-655). Every LIVE_EXECUTE read: chainRegistry.ts:721-724 (strict "true"), exitTrigger.ts:174 (from the registry), preflight.ts:629-630 (from env, same strictness). No dashboard or Telegram path flips it at runtime.
severity_rationale: S2. Going live on a chain whose detector never saw a pool event during the "dry run" (for example the bot ran for one minute a week ago) turns on emergency sells with minOut 0 and a 2x gas bid against an unvalidated detector; the loss is bounded per position and needs the operator to flip the switch. Section-C item SC-11 (L1).
recommendation: Decide in Phase 32 (card OD-19, owned there; no local card) what the floor measures: monitored time with the bot running and positions registered, a minimum count of evaluated events with zero false positives, and a reset when the detector code or its thresholds change. Until then treat the stamp as a lower bound only.
